mainEntity.name: How much does a workplace retaliation attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a workplace retaliation attorney can vary. Many attorneys in this field work on a contingency fee basis, meaning they only get paid if you win your case, and their fee is a percentage of the settlement or award. You might also encounter hourly rates or flat fees for initial consultations or specific services. It's important to discuss fee structures upfront during your initial consultation to understand all potential costs involved.
